releases.notes:
**Update**
- Added a "FromSpawner" NBT attribute to mobs, which when TRUE will prevent MobAbsorption from occurring
- Added a MobAbsorption blacklist to the Config
- Added a "Despawn" item property to the Config to allow setting faster despawn on dropped items
  - Can add items to this list and they will despawn at different rates than vanilla (5 minutes)
- **Fixed:** NullPointerException caused when breaking ArmorStands
- **Fixed:** NullPointerException caused when attempting to drop backpacks into death chests
- **Fixed:** The default SQLite value is now correctly "false" allowing for SQL servers to be used again
- **Fixed:** Hostile mob checks (All `HostileEntity`s are `Monster`s, but not all `Monster`s are `HostileEntity`s)
- **Fixed:** Added a patch Mixin to the `/worldborder` command to use 1.17 behavior of selecting the players current world
  - Useful if `worlds.separate_properties.worldborder` is enabled in the config (Allowing per-world world borders)

releases.notes:
- Updated to Minecraft 1.15.2
- Added command to reload mod config in-game
- Added command to reload permission config in-game
- Added command to mute players (Globally or per-player)
- Added subcommand to permissions to update all permissions to a specific rank
- Added a command for viewing and modifying ranks and permissions
- Added a permission check for starting raids in villages
- Added a permission check for hopper item transfer
- Added a purchasable Backpack for players, can use "/backpack" command to open:
  - Using a subcommand of "/backpack" players can set dropped items to automatically be inserted into the backpack
- Added a new Backpack shop sign
- Added a "Forged by" and "Tool rarity" lore to tools modified in the anvil
- Added the world year and day to death messages
- Added custom trade options to the wandering trader
- Added option for using Totem of Undying located anywhere in the players inventory
- Added Mute, Kick, Ban permissions
- Regular cows will now (optionally) eat mycelium to become mooshrooms
- Changed End-Teleport command to use vanilla teleporting, which will generate a spawn platform if one does not exist
- Changed how item rarity is calculated
- Changed formatting of whisper messages
- Changed villagers to be able to be considered members of a town claim
- Changed Spawn Eggs to only apply to a mob spawner if the player is in CREATIVE mode
- Changed the teleport effect from a puff of smoke to a spiral swirl
- Changed sleep message to split game days into years
- Creatures falling into the void in The End will be teleported into the Overworld
- Mobs sitting on a players shoulder, attached on leads, or following a player will be teleported by Waystones, `/spawn`, and `/tpa`.
- Added new config options:
  - Chat format
  - If players can mute other players
  - If OPs can globally mute players
  - If players can add friends to the whitelist
  - If players should start with all recipes unlocked
  - If the "/backpack" command is allowed
  - If backpacks must be upgraded to each specific size
  - If players start the game with a backpack unlocked
  - If cows should eat mycelium to turn back into mooshrooms
  - If the anvil repair cost should be disabled
  - If unnamed villagers should spawn with a name
  - Name of the worlds epoch
  - If villagers should be included as part of towns
  - How many villagers in a town equals 1 player being in the town
- Fixed Infinity enchantment to no longer require that the player have an arrow in their inventory
- Fixed XP being picked up to only apply to mending to equipment that needs repairing
- Fixed permission issue where pistons and sticky pistons could interact with claimed land
  - Flying machines can no longer move into claimed land that they do not have permission for
  - Sticky pistons can no longer be used to pull blocks out of claimed areas
- Flaming arrows now leave a particle trail as they fly
- Dying the collar of a Wolf or Cat will change the color of the mobs name
- Fixed bug preventing end crystals from being destroyable in the overworld / nether again (Normally checks if there's a dragon nearby)
- Fixed claiming of new randomized waystones from WARP signs
- Fixed logging being skipped if claims are disabled

Updated to Minecraft 1.15.1

Added "Ghast Griefing" claim option
Added Withers to take permissions of where they were built
Started implementing additional "fun" options for bubble columns
Started implementing vein-miner and tree-capacitator
